1. (Currently Amended) A cosmetic composition comprising an indole compound of formula I:

__wherein R1, R2, R3, R4, R5, R6, R7, R8, R9 and R10 are independently selected from hydrogen, halogen, alkyl, alkoxy, aryl, heteroaryl, or combinations thereof, and/or a physiologically acceptable salt thereof, for topical application to human skin for cosmetic care purposes.__

3. (Currently Amended) Composition for topical use comprising a) the active ingredient according to Claim 1, b) one or more skin-tolerated vehicles, and c) optionally one or more further active compounds having a skin-care __action__.

4. (Currently Amended) Composition according to __Claim 1 or 3__, wherein the active ingredient is contained in said composition in an amount of 0,00001 per cent by weight to 10 per cent by weight.

5. (Cancelled)

6. (Currently Amended) Composition according to claim __3__, comprising as a further skin-care ingredient ectoine, __in an amount of 0.01 to 10 per cent by weight__.

7. (Currently Amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the manufacture of a cosmetic composition __for topical application to human skin__.

8. (Currently Amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the preparation of a composition which is suitable for the __treatment__ of skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation relating to differentiation and cell proliferation, __for the treatment of acne vulgaris, acne comedonica, polymorphic acne, acne rosaceae, nodular acne, acne conglobata, age-related acne, acne occurring as a side effect, such as acne solaris, medicament-related acne or acne professionalis, for the treatment of other defects of keratinisation, ichthyosis, ichthyosiform states, Darier's disease, keratosis palmo-plantaris, leukoplakia, leukoplakiform states, skin and mucosal (buccal) eczema (lichen), for the treatment of other skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation and have an inflammatory component, all forms of psoriasis relating to the skin, mucous membranes and finger- and toenails, and psoriatic rheumatism and skin atopy, such as eczema, or respiratory atopy, or also hypertrophy of the gums__.

9. (Currently Amended) Use according to Claim 8 for hair care __and hair follicle treatment__.

10. (Currently Amended) Use __of__ the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the care, preservation or improvement of the general state of the skin or hair __by topical application__.

12. (Currently Amended) Use of the __active ingredient__ according to Claim 1 for skin lightening and/or skin whitening.

13. (Currently Amended) Use __of__ the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the __reduction__ of skin unevenness, such as wrinkles, fine lines, rough skin or large-pored skin.

14. (Currently Amended) Use __of__ the active ingredient of Claim 1 for __reducing__ time- and/or light-induced ageing processes of the human skin or human hair, __for reducing dry skin, wrinkle formation and/or pigment defects, and/or for the reduction of the harmful effects of UV rays on the skin__.
